examples: Turn stats off and clear: usage stats rebuilds its small database from your transcripts, keeping your charts, settings and recorded activity.
how_to: Switch collect stats off. Every stats widget now says stats off.
Press clear stats and reclaim space, then clear stats to confirm. Usage stats rebuilds from your transcripts.
Switch collect stats on; backfill and catch up also rebuilds. The panel counts the conversations left.
media_exempt: a settings panel whose clear action is destructive; the capture would need a seeded stats database
name: Stats collection
summary: usage stats is a core feature with one on/off switch in Settings; switch collection off, clear what it collected to reclaim the disk, and backfill to catch up when you turn it back on.
